claim: 4-1-4-1 was added to the formation picker

4-1-4-1 formation includes a back four of RB, CB, CB, LB
4-1-4-1 formation includes a midfield four of RM, CM, CM, LM

With 3 columns and 7 formations one button would have been alone on the last row
The formation buttons are narrower as a result of the column change
The page was not opened in a browser after the changes
A draft was not tested with the new formation
Player eligibility code required no changes for 4-1-4-1
Every position in 4-1-4-1 is a position already used by the game
